pages.title: Enemy Tantou
pages.text: Tantou-type monsters are small in size and difficult to hit. They boast fast attack speed and high damage, with the highest spawn frequency among all Retrograde Army monsters.

pages.name: Enemy Tantou
pages.text: The basic tantou unit of the Retrograde Army. Small and agile, extremely difficult to hit, with very fast attack speed.

pages.name: Enemy Specialized Tantou
pages.text: A specialized enemy tantou with further increased attack power and movement speed, posing a significantly greater threat.

pages.name: Enemy Kiwame Tantou
pages.text: The Kiwame form of enemy tantou, possessing the highest attack speed and damage among all tantou-type monsters.
